technical_and_design_decisions: Use Java 17 and JUnit 5 in alignment with Spring Framework 6 test suite standards.
Implement acceptance test suites using Spring Boot Test and Spring Cloud Stream/Data Flow testing utilities where applicable.

Mock external service dependencies (e.g., HTTP Event Collector for Splunk sink using WireMock, lightweight Spark execution context for Spark-App job) to keep tests fast and deterministic in CI pipelines.
Ensure test isolation and clean-up after execution so test runs do not leave residual data or locked files.
assumptions: The sink modules and batch jobs described in U1-U8 are already implemented; the scope is restricted to acceptance test suite development and CI integration.
The CI pipeline environment supports running Docker containers or necessary test environments for integration assertions.
The developer is performing all test implementation, local execution, and CI configuration individually.

activities.activity_description: Configure base acceptance test framework, shared test utilities, and environment configuration for running module acceptance tests.
Implement acceptance test cases verifying that messages routed to the null sink module are correctly consumed and silently dropped without errors.

activities.activity_name: U2: Rich Gauge Sink Acceptance Tests
activities.activity_description: Implement acceptance test cases verifying gauge metric updates and formatting when events reach the rich_gauge sink.
Implement acceptance test cases for expression-based payload routing to target destinations in the router sink.
Implement acceptance test cases executing shell commands via the shell sink and verifying output capture and process exit codes.
Implement acceptance test cases using a mock HTTP Event Collector (HEC) endpoint to verify event formatting and delivery to Splunk.
Implement acceptance test cases verifying sampling rate calculations, throughput metrics, and log/metric generation.

activities.activity_name: U7: Spark-App Batch Job Acceptance Tests
activities.activity_description: Implement acceptance test cases executing the spark-app batch job task, verifying job submission, parameter handling, and status completion.

activities.activity_name: U8: Timestampfile Batch Job Acceptance Tests
activities.activity_description: Implement acceptance test cases verifying execution of the timestampfile batch job and asserting timestamp file output creation on disk.
Integrate new acceptance test tasks into the CI build script, address test stability/flakiness, and verify automated execution in CI.
